name: InboxMCP
author: Logike SAS (Breakcold)
description: Connect LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram to AI assistants for inbox reading, replies, profile research and user-approved messaging. Hosted MCP with OAuth 2.1 and PKCE. Free trial, then paid subscription.

tools.name: linkedin_status
tools.description: Call before planning several LinkedIn actions. Says whether the account can act now (blocked_reason), how many actions are left today (profile_views → linkedin_get_profile, searches → linkedin_search_people, messages → linkedin_send_message, new_conversations → linkedin_start_chat, invitations → linkedin_send_invitation, posts → linkedin_create_post; invitations also have a weekly limit), and ready_in_seconds for each: the wait before that action can run. Reading the inbox has a high limit and is not listed. No account or a disconnected one: use linkedin_connect_account. Plan or seats: use inboxmcp_billing. For WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram accounts, use inbox_status.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts; default: the first LinkedIn account

tools.name: inbox_status
tools.description: Status and limits of one connected account, any provider (LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram). Call before planning several actions. Says whether the account can act now (blocked_reason), how many actions are left today (messages → *_send_message, new_conversations → *_start_chat, profile_views → *_get_profile, posts → linkedin_create_post / instagram_create_post; on LinkedIn also searches and invitations), and ready_in_seconds for each. Reading has a high limit and is not listed. No account or a disconnected one: use connect_account. Plan or seats: use inboxmcp_billing.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts. Needed only when several accounts are connected.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Get a link for the user to connect a LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram account, or to reconnect one that was logged out. Before giving the link, tell the user what the result says about the free trial or price. They log in on our connect page in their browser (LinkedIn and Instagram: their login; WhatsApp and Telegram: scan a QR code). Never ask for passwords or codes in the chat. The link works for 30 minutes. Afterwards, call inbox_list_accounts to confirm.

mode.description: auto: reconnect the current account if it needs it, otherwise add one if none is connected. new: add another account. reconnect: log the current account back in.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts: the one to reconnect, when several of this network are connected

tools.name: linkedin_connect_account
tools.description: Get a link for the user to connect a LinkedIn account, or to reconnect one LinkedIn logged out. Before giving the link, tell the user what the result says about the free trial or price. They log in to LinkedIn in their browser on our connect page (never ask for their LinkedIn password or codes in the chat). The link works for 30 minutes. Afterwards, call linkedin_status to confirm.

mode.description: auto: reconnect the current account if it needs it, otherwise add one if none is connected. new: add another account. reconnect: log the current account back in.

tools.name: inboxmcp_billing
tools.description: The user's inbox MCP plan: free trial (3 days, starts when the first account is connected) or subscription ($10/month per connected account, any provider), with a link to our billing page to subscribe, update their card, get invoices, or cancel (payment happens on Stripe, in their browser). The link works for 30 minutes. Use it when the tools say the trial or subscription ended.

tools.name: inbox_list_accounts
tools.description: The LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram and Instagram accounts this connection can use, with their account_id, provider, name and status. Pass account_id as `account` to the inbox_* and provider tools (linkedin_*, whatsapp_*, telegram_*, instagram_*) when more than one is connected.

tools.name: inbox_list_chats
tools.description: Conversations across every connected inbox (LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram), merged and sorted most recent first; account or provider narrows it. Use unread=true to triage. Each item has chat_id, its account_id and provider (pass account_id as account to inbox_get_messages / inbox_send_message when several accounts are connected), and person_id for 1-to-1 chats. Accounts that can't be read right now are listed in skipped, with what to do.

account.description: Only this account (account_id from inbox_list_accounts); default: every connected account, merged

fresh.description: Bypass the 1h cache (costs a provider call)

tools.name: inbox_get_messages
tools.description: Messages in one conversation, most recent first. 'from' is 'me' (the account owner) or 'them'.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several accounts are connected.

tools.name: inbox_send_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing conversation, on any connected provider. Plain text. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several accounts are connected.

tools.name: inbox_start_chat
tools.description: Message someone you have no conversation with yet. `to`: on LinkedIn the person_id (1st-degree connections; for InMail use linkedin_start_chat), on WhatsApp a phone number with country code, on Telegram the user id, on Instagram the user id. New conversations have a low daily limit, especially on WhatsApp, where cold messages get new accounts banned. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several accounts are connected.

to.description: Recipient: person_id, phone number (WhatsApp) or user id

tools.name: inbox_mark_read
tools.description: Marks a conversation read (or unread), on any connected provider.

account.description: account_id from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_list_chats
tools.description: Conversations in the LinkedIn inbox, most recent first. Use unread=true to triage. Returns chat_id values for linkedin_get_messages / linkedin_send_message and person_id for 1-to-1 chats. With several LinkedIn accounts, lists them all merged (each item has its account_id: pass it as account to the other linkedin_* tools); account narrows to one.

account.description: Only this account (account_id from inbox_list_accounts); default: every connected LinkedIn account, merged

fresh.description: Bypass the 1h cache (costs a LinkedIn call)

tools.name: linkedin_get_messages
tools.description: Messages in one conversation, most recent first. 'from' is 'me' (the account owner) or 'them'.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_send_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing conversation. Plain text. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_start_chat
tools.description: Message someone you are connected with (1st degree). For others, set inmail=true (needs a LinkedIn premium plan with InMail credits). Get the person_id from linkedin_search_people or linkedin_get_profile.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

person_id.description: LinkedIn user id of the recipient

tools.name: linkedin_mark_read
tools.description: Marks a conversation read (or unread).

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_search_people
tools.description: Search LinkedIn members by keywords, or paste a LinkedIn people-search URL copied from the browser (keeps all its filters). Each page costs one LinkedIn search. Returns person_id values for other tools.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_get_profile
tools.description: Full profile by person_id or public identifier (the part after linkedin.com/in/). Counts as a profile view on LinkedIn.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_send_invitation
tools.description: Invite someone to connect, optionally with a note (max 300 characters, 200 on free LinkedIn accounts, which can add a note to about 15 invitations a week). Limited per day and per week, and LinkedIn actions are spaced about a minute apart; check linkedin_status first.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_list_invitations
tools.description: Pending invitations you sent or received.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_create_post
tools.description: Publish a text post on the account's feed. A link can be appended; LinkedIn builds the preview from the first URL in the text. Public and irreversible from here: confirm the final text with the user first.

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_schedule_outreach
tools.description: Queue up to 50 messages or invitations. They are sent one by one with random gaps of a minute or more, respecting daily limits. An invitation's text is its note (max 300 characters, 200 on free LinkedIn accounts). Returns a job_id; poll with linkedin_get_job. Confirm the list with the user first.

person_id.description: for kind=invitation, or kind=message to start a new conversation

account.description: account_id of a LinkedIn account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several LinkedIn accounts are connected.

tools.name: linkedin_get_job
tools.description: Progress and per-item results of a job from linkedin_schedule_outreach.

tools.name: whatsapp_list_chats
tools.description: WhatsApp chats (1-to-1 and groups), most recent first. Use unread=true to triage. Returns chat_id values for whatsapp_get_messages / whatsapp_send_message, and person_id (the contact's WhatsApp id, <digits>@s.whatsapp.net) for 1-to-1 chats; for a group's members use whatsapp_list_group_members. With several WhatsApp accounts, lists them all merged (each item has its account_id: pass it as account to the other whatsapp_* tools); account narrows to one.

account.description: Only this account (account_id from inbox_list_accounts); default: every connected WhatsApp account, merged

fresh.description: Bypass the 1h cache (costs a WhatsApp call)

tools.name: whatsapp_get_messages
tools.description: Messages in one WhatsApp chat, most recent first. 'from' is 'me' (the account owner) or 'them'. message_id values work with whatsapp_react.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

tools.name: whatsapp_send_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing WhatsApp chat (1-to-1 or group). Plain text. WhatsApp actions are spaced 10–20 s apart. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

tools.name: whatsapp_start_chat
tools.description: Message a phone number you have no WhatsApp chat with yet. phone: international format with its country code, like +33 6 12 34 56 78. WhatsApp bans accounts that send cold messages (new accounts after 2–3), so only message people who expect it; at most 10 new chats a day. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

phone.description: Phone number with its country code, like +33 6 12 34 56 78

tools.name: whatsapp_mark_read
tools.description: Marks a WhatsApp chat read (or unread).

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

tools.name: whatsapp_react
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (message_id from whatsapp_get_messages). Any emoji works; a new reaction replaces yours.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_profile
tools.description: A WhatsApp user's profile: name, username, phone when WhatsApp shares it, bio, followers and picture. Counts as a profile view.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

user_id.description: The contact's WhatsApp id (a chat's person_id, <digits>@s.whatsapp.net) or phone number with country code

tools.name: whatsapp_list_group_members
tools.description: Members of a WhatsApp group chat (chat_id from whatsapp_list_chats), with their user_id for whatsapp_get_profile and their phone number. Group chats only.

account.description: account_id of a WhatsApp account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several WhatsApp accounts are connected.

tools.name: telegram_list_chats
tools.description: Telegram chats (private chats and groups), most recent first. Use unread=true to triage. Returns chat_id values for telegram_get_messages / telegram_send_message, and person_id (the contact's Telegram user id) for private chats; for a group's members use telegram_list_group_members. With several Telegram accounts, lists them all merged (each item has its account_id: pass it as account to the other telegram_* tools); account narrows to one.

account.description: Only this account (account_id from inbox_list_accounts); default: every connected Telegram account, merged

fresh.description: Bypass the 1h cache (costs a Telegram call)

tools.name: telegram_get_messages
tools.description: Messages in one Telegram chat, most recent first. 'from' is 'me' (the account owner) or 'them'. message_id values work with telegram_react.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

tools.name: telegram_send_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing Telegram chat (private or group). Plain text. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

tools.name: telegram_start_chat
tools.description: Message a Telegram user you have no chat with yet, by numeric user id (a chat's person_id, or a member from telegram_list_group_members). Telegram restricts accounts that message many strangers, so only message people who expect it; at most 10 new chats a day. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

user_id.description: Telegram user id of the recipient

tools.name: telegram_mark_read
tools.description: Marks a Telegram chat read (or unread).

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

tools.name: telegram_react
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (message_id from telegram_get_messages). Telegram accepts only its standard reaction emojis (👍 ❤️ 🔥 🎉 😁 👏 …); others fail.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

tools.name: telegram_get_profile
tools.description: A Telegram user's profile: name, username, phone when Telegram shares it, bio, followers and picture. Counts as a profile view.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

user_id.description: Telegram user id (a chat's person_id or a group member's user_id)

tools.name: telegram_list_group_members
tools.description: Members of a Telegram group chat (chat_id from telegram_list_chats), with their user_id for telegram_get_profile. Group chats only.

account.description: account_id of a Telegram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Telegram accounts are connected.

tools.name: instagram_list_chats
tools.description: Instagram direct messages, most recent first. Use unread=true to triage. Returns chat_id values for instagram_get_messages / instagram_send_message, and person_id (the contact's Instagram user id) for 1-to-1 chats. With several Instagram accounts, lists them all merged (each item has its account_id: pass it as account to the other instagram_* tools); account narrows to one.

account.description: Only this account (account_id from inbox_list_accounts); default: every connected Instagram account, merged

fresh.description: Bypass the 1h cache (costs a Instagram call)

tools.name: instagram_get_messages
tools.description: Messages in one Instagram conversation, most recent first. 'from' is 'me' (the account owner) or 'them'. message_id values work with instagram_react.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

tools.name: instagram_send_message
tools.description: Reply in an existing Instagram direct conversation. Plain text. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

tools.name: instagram_start_chat
tools.description: Send a direct message to an Instagram user you have no conversation with yet, by user id (a chat's person_id, or from instagram_get_profile). Messages to people who don't follow the account land in their message requests, and Instagram restricts accounts that message many strangers: only message people who expect it; at most 10 new conversations a day. Show the user the exact text before calling this.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

user_id.description: Instagram user id of the recipient

tools.name: instagram_mark_read
tools.description: Marks an Instagram conversation read (or unread).

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

tools.name: instagram_react
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message (message_id from instagram_get_messages). Instagram keeps one reaction per person: a new one replaces yours.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

tools.name: instagram_get_profile
tools.description: A Instagram user's profile: name, username, phone when Instagram shares it, bio, followers and picture. Counts as a profile view.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

user_id.description: Instagram user id (a chat's person_id) or username

tools.name: instagram_list_posts
tools.description: Posts of an Instagram user, most recent first: the account's own by default, or someone else's with user_id. Returns caption, link, date, likes and comments.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

user_id.description: Instagram user id or username; default: the account's own posts

tools.name: instagram_create_post
tools.description: Publish a photo on the account's Instagram feed: image_url is an https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP (at most 8 MB), text is the caption. Public and irreversible from here: confirm the image and the caption with the user first.

account.description: account_id of a Instagram account from inbox_list_accounts (a listed chat's account_id). Needed only when several Instagram accounts are connected.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search LinkedIn people by keywords. Returns ids usable with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a full record by id from search: person:<id> or chat:<id>.
